name: example-workflow-cbd
title: Example Workflow (CBD)
description: Run the example workflow through its maintained reference codebase. Use when the user asks to process an example input into the documented output.
purpose: Provide a reviewed, repeatable entry point to an existing custom workflow without copying its integrated implementation.
triggers: Run the example workflow on these inputs.
nonTriggers: Rewrite or refactor the reference implementation.

inputs.name: example_input
inputs.description: Input file accepted by the maintained workflow.

outputs.name: example_output
outputs.description: Validated result produced by the workflow.

steps.summary: Validate the input before invoking the maintained workflow.
steps.rationale: The source documentation defines the required input contract.
The inspected entrypoint exposes this command-line contract.

dependencies.name: reference-workflow
dependencies.notes: Resolved at runtime through the CBD config.

notes: Validate the maintained environment specification before approving the skill.

evidence.summary: The notes identify the required input type.
The notes identify the required output artifact.
The maintained script exposes the documented workflow entrypoint.

assumptions: The configured codebase version remains compatible with the inspected entrypoint.
qualityChecks: The required output exists and is non-empty.

failureModes.trigger: The configured codebase root or entrypoint is missing.
failureModes.response: Stop and request an updated codebase location; do not substitute another script.

licenseDecision: No custom code is copied in CBD mode.
